استعرضن (form X)
# اِسْتَعْرَضْنَ (istaʕraḍna) /is.taʕ.radˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
# اُسْتُعْرِضْنَ (ustuʕriḍna) /us.tuʕ.ridˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
# اِسْتَعْرِضْنَ (istaʕriḍna) /is.taʕ.ridˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
